rationales: Pascal is a derived unit of pressure.
Kilogramme is an SI base unit, not a derived unit.
Newton is a derived unit of force.
Watt is a derived unit of power.
Rotatory motion is the spinning of a body about its axis.
Vibratory motion is repeated back-and-forth motion.
Circular motion is motion along a circular path, not necessarily spinning about the body's own axis.
Random motion has no fixed path or direction.
Distance is a scalar quantity.
Weight is a force and therefore a vector quantity.
Mass is a scalar quantity.
Speed is a scalar quantity.
Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
Momentum is the product of mass and velocity.
Power is the rate of doing work.
Work is the product of force and displacement in the direction of the force.
Increasing speed does not by itself make a racing car more stable.
Decreasing mass alone does not ensure greater stability.
Decreasing width can make a car less stable.
Lowering the centre of gravity increases stability.
Pascal’s law describes pressure transmission in a fluid, not how to determine density.
Hooke’s law relates force to extension within the elastic limit.
The principle of floatation concerns the weight of a floating body and displaced fluid.
Archimedes’ principle can be used to determine a substance’s density from its upthrust.
10⁴ N m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
10³ N m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
10⁻² N m⁻² is less than one pascal.
One pascal equals 1 N m⁻².
15 °C is below normal human body temperature.
37 °F is far below normal human body temperature.
98.8 °C is dangerously high and not normal body temperature.
Normal human body temperature is approximately 37 °C.
0.01 mm is not the standard least count for the usual school vernier callipers.
The usual school vernier callipers have a least count of 0.01 cm, or 0.1 mm.
1 mm is too large for the usual vernier callipers' least count.
1 cm is far too large for the least count.
Geophysics studies the physical structure and properties of the Earth.
Light is a topic in optics, not the study of Earth's internal structure.
Atomic physics studies atoms and their constituents.
Heat is a topic concerning thermal energy, not Earth's internal structure.
Speed is the rate of change of distance.
Velocity is the rate of change of displacement.
Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
Deceleration is negative acceleration or a decrease in velocity.
The newton is the SI unit of force.
The pascal is the SI unit of pressure.
The joule is the SI unit of energy and work.
The kilogram is the SI unit of mass.
Torque is the turning effect of a force.
Momentum is the product of mass and velocity.
Pressure is force per unit area.
Force is the cause of the turning effect, not its name.
The acceleration due to gravity at the Moon’s surface is about 1.62 m s⁻².
10 m s⁻² is approximately Earth's gravitational acceleration, not the Moon's.
9.8 m s⁻² is Earth's approximate gravitational acceleration.
20 m s⁻² is not the Moon’s surface gravitational acceleration.
Water stored in a dam does not primarily store electric energy.
Dam water stores gravitational potential energy because it is elevated.
Kinetic energy is associated with motion, not water at rest in a dam.
Thermal energy is not the main form of energy stored in dam water.
